newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fujitsu to boost cell phone output to 3 mln units.
newsitem.headline: Fujitsu to boost cell phone output to 3 mln units.

text.p: Fujitsu Ltd said on Thursday it would increase its annual production target for cellular phones to about three million units for the year to March 31, 1998.
The company produced about 1.8 million units in 1996/97, a Fujitsu spokesman said.
He did not provide the cost of the planned expansion, which would take place at Fujitsu's only mobile phone manufacturing line in Nasu, central Japan.

"We expect an increase in domestic demand. It has been said that demand has temporarily stopped rising, but we believe it is necessary to produce more as we think demand will start to rise again," the spokesman said.
The spokesman also said Fujitsu expects to increase cellular phone production for export and to begin Personal Handyphone System (PHS) production for export in the future.
